Checking consistency: with p = 3, q = 1, k = 2, f(x) = 2/(x−3) + 1 gives f(1) = 0 (x-intercept matches), f(−8) ≈ 0.82, f(8) = 1.4, and the branches blow up at x = 3 — all matching the plotted curve.

Therefore, p = 3.
